protocol.metrics: Normalized autocorrelation Euclidean pseudometric; joint Hamming quotient metric; latter plus 0.25 normalized time by Euclidean product. Exact Rips H0/H1 on <=16 points, positive finite bars (infinite H0 omitted), discretized integral Betti and lifetime summaries; same matrices' distance histograms, direct invariant trigram cosine, optional all-transposition local chroma alignment. Fixed rules, no tuning.
protocol.bach: All 382 references, official 77 test pieces with deterministic synthetic changes; different random draws than XVIII.
protocol.folk: Independently contributed symbolic settings, same tune IDs or annotated tune families, no self match. Different-tune family test excludes all same-ID settings. One representative per ID chosen by smallest numeric setting ID, separately aligned. No audio/timbre test.

meta.parser: Conservative subset ABC: pitch classes only, key signatures and explicit bar-local accidentals; skip chords/inline headers and unsupported keys, omit durations, grace notes, ornaments and rests, notate repeats as written (no expansion). No labels used in feature extraction.
